subsystems.title: Pairing

clean: Connect a new client or sender and complete its pairing approval.
Reconnect after approval and confirm it does not ask to pair again.
copied: Confirm an already-approved client or sender remains trusted after upgrade.
Pair one new client or sender and confirm both old and new identities work.

passEvidence: The approval is visible and the paired identity can reconnect and act.
safety: Use an identity you control; redact pairing codes from notes.

subsystems.title: Channels

clean: Choose the channel you know best and configure it from a clean state.
Send a direct message and a threaded or group reply when the channel supports them.
copied: With the source gateway stopped, prove the inherited channel can receive and reply.
Remove that channel configuration only from the copied fixture, configure it again, and repeat the round trip.

passEvidence: Inbound and outbound messages arrive once, in the expected conversation or thread.
safety: Only one gateway may own copied channel credentials at a time.

subsystems.title: Control UI

clean: Open the Control UI and start a real conversation asking the agent to explore a substantial codebase.
Drive many tool calls, spawn subagents, cross a compaction boundary, reload, and continue.
copied: Open an existing conversation and verify its history before sending new work.
Continue through tools, subagents, compaction, reload, and reconnect.

passEvidence: The conversation remains responsive and continuous across tools, compaction, reload, and reconnect.
safety: Use a disposable workspace for write-capable exploration.

subsystems.title: TUI

clean: Launch the TUI through OCM, send a message, use a picker or shortcut, and switch sessions.
copied: Launch the TUI and open existing history, then send a new message and reconnect.

passEvidence: History, input, streaming, tool cards, shortcuts, and reconnect behave coherently.

subsystems.title: Onboarding

clean: Complete onboarding on the current host; use a VPS as a separate run when available.
Restart through OCM and confirm the configured model and channel remain usable.
copied: Run the supported configuration flow without overwriting preserved settings.
Reconfigure one intentionally removed surface and restart.

passEvidence: A competent user can finish setup and reach a working conversation without manual file repair.
safety: Never point onboarding at the source gateway state directory.

subsystems.title: Slash commands

clean: Exercise status, session, model, and compaction commands from one supported client.
copied: Run the same commands in an existing conversation and confirm they target the upgraded gateway.

passEvidence: Each command produces a visible result or a clear actionable error.

subsystems.title: Memory

clean: Teach the agent a unique canary fact, start a later session, and ask it to recall the fact.
copied: Recall one pre-upgrade memory, add a new canary, restart, and recall both.

passEvidence: Pre-existing and newly written memory remain distinguishable and retrievable.
safety: Use invented canaries, not personal secrets.

subsystems.title: Subagents

clean: Delegate at least two independent subtasks and wait for their results.
copied: Repeat delegation in an existing session and verify parent-child results survive reconnect.

passEvidence: Children start, report progress, return results to the correct parent, and terminate cleanly.

subsystems.title: Agents (top-level)

clean: Create a second top-level agent, give it a distinct workspace, and start a session.
copied: Open an existing agent, create another one, and verify sessions remain attributed correctly.

passEvidence: Agent identity, workspace, model, and sessions stay isolated and correctly routed.

subsystems.title: Cron

clean: Create a near-term one-shot job and a recurring job, then observe one delivery.
copied: Verify existing jobs are still listed, let one run, then create and remove a new job.

passEvidence: Jobs persist, fire once at the intended time, record an outcome, and can be removed.
safety: Use a private destination and remove test jobs after proof.

subsystems.title: Sessions

clean: Create sessions from two clients, list them, reopen one, restart the gateway, and continue.
copied: Open a pre-upgrade session, continue it, restart, and verify old plus new turns remain ordered.

passEvidence: Session identity, transcript ordering, and continuation survive client and gateway restarts.

subsystems.title: Context Engine

clean: Run a task that needs workspace instructions, skills, memory, and several tool results.
copied: Continue a context-heavy existing session and verify preserved instructions still govern behavior.

passEvidence: Relevant context is present, bounded, ordered deterministically, and applied by the model.

subsystems.title: Skill Workshop

clean: Create or install a small disposable skill, invoke it, edit it, and invoke the revision.
copied: Invoke one preserved skill, then create or revise a disposable skill and invoke it in a new session.

passEvidence: The skill is visible, loads completely, changes take effect at the documented lifecycle boundary, and invocation succeeds.
safety: Do not publish the disposable skill.

subsystems.title: MCP

clean: Configure one familiar MCP server, discover its tools, and complete a real tool call.
copied: Verify a preserved MCP server reconnects, then invoke one tool and inspect its result.

passEvidence: Discovery, schemas, invocation, and returned content are correct and actionable.
safety: Prefer a read-only or disposable MCP target.

subsystems.title: Models

clean: Configure a model, make a real turn, switch models, and make another turn.
copied: Verify the preserved default model works, switch models, restart, and confirm the intended selection.

passEvidence: Catalog loading, auth, selection, persistence, and real responses work without hidden fallback.
safety: Record model identifiers but never credentials.

subsystems.title: Approvals

clean: Trigger a harmless operation requiring approval, deny it once, then trigger and approve it.
copied: Verify preserved approval policy, then exercise both denial and approval paths.

passEvidence: The request is visible, denial prevents execution, approval executes exactly once, and the agent receives the outcome.

subsystems.title: Compaction

clean: Build a long tool-heavy conversation, trigger compaction, and ask questions about early and recent facts.
copied: Continue a long existing conversation through compaction and verify continuity before and after restart.

passEvidence: Compaction completes visibly, the conversation continues, and essential goals plus recent state survive.
safety: Use synthetic content rather than sensitive transcripts.

subsystems.title: Codex harness

clean: Run a medium coding task through the Codex harness with tools, progress, and a final artifact.
copied: Resume or begin a Codex-harness task after upgrade and verify tools, thread identity, and compaction.

passEvidence: The task completes with correct thread identity, tool results, progress, and a verifiable artifact.

subsystems.title: OpenClaw harness

clean: Run the same medium coding-task shape through the OpenClaw harness, including tools, subagents, and compaction.
copied: Run or resume the task after upgrade and compare continuity, progress, and artifact quality with the Codex harness.

passEvidence: The task completes without dead ends and produces a verifiable artifact with coherent progress and context.
